stripe is 1+1: the draft has several node sets, and each becomes a member cluster of a supercluster that stripes across its own nodes alone, so the scheme is one the smallest node set, of 3 storage nodes, carries. Delete the node sets you do not want, or widen the stripe if every node set you keep carries more. A cluster's stripe cannot be changed afterward
enableNodeAffinity is set, because a 1+1 stripe is a mirror and reads are served from the local node's copy first. The control plane takes it at cluster create and never re-applies it, so this is the line to remove now if reads should not prefer the local node
wrote discovered-discover-role-10 in Draft: 32 workers with 128 nvme devices, in 3 group(s) across 3 node set(s); 0 refusal(s)
